Interestingly, the text records that Abraham also looked upon the destruction of the two cities with no dire consequences (seeGenesis 19:27–28). The Hebrew word describing Abraham’s “look” means simply to “watch” (see Longman and Strauss,The Baker Expository Dictionary, entry 8259, page 1030).

Genesis 21:13. The Lord made a similar promise to Hagar inverse 18. A description of Ishmael’s posterity is found inGenesis 25:12–18.
The word translated as “tempt” inGenesis 22:1means to “test, or prove” (Genesis 22:1, footnotea).
Genesis 22:8. Abraham’s words reflect his faith that God was directing the situation.
